comment: How to play (see HowTo, scenes/how_to/how_to.gd, and dev/how_to/make_svgs.py): the parts, one after the other, for one rower, two rowers, or both ('players'). Each part lasts 'seconds' and shows: on the left, the players in the camera picture (mirrored, as the players see themselves), and on the right, what it does ('panel': 'boat', the boat from above; 'jetty', the boat and a jetty; 'card', a card of the screens). The 'moves' say what the players do, from 'from' to 'to' seconds into the part: 'row' (strokes, one every 'period' seconds; 'who': 0 the left rower, 1 the right one, -1 all), 'lean' (to the 'side': -1 left, 1 right), 'brake' (both hands above the head), 'point' (one hand raised to the card) or 'rest'. A part starts with the boat at rest, unless it has 'keep_boat'. The 'stills' are the moments drawn into the SVGs.

parts.title: Sit facing the camera
parts.text: Sit on a chair, two steps from the camera, so that it sees you from your head to your belly.

parts.title: Row
parts.text: Lean back and pull your hands to your belly, then lean forward and reach out. Every stroke pushes the boat.

parts.title: Glide
parts.text: Stop rowing, and the boat glides on, slower and slower. Row a few strokes, then glide.

parts.title: Steer to the left
parts.text: Lean to the left with your whole body, and the boat turns left. Lean more to turn harder.

parts.title: Steer to the right
parts.text: Lean to the right, and the boat turns right. Sit up straight again to go straight on.

parts.title: Row together
parts.text: Each of you pulls the oar on your side. Row in time, and the oars shine gold: the boat goes fastest.

parts.title: Turn
parts.text: The boat turns away from the stronger rower: the left rower rows alone, and the boat turns right.

parts.title: Brake
parts.text: Raise both hands above your head, and the boat stops.

parts.title: Dock at a jetty
parts.text: Glide slowly to a jetty, and you dock there: trade, take tasks, or sleep at home.

parts.title: Choose
parts.text: Raise a hand to a card and hold it still until the rope ring is full.
